title: 10 open source repos that turn Claude Code into a motion studio
prompt_text: HyperFrames, Remotion, Remotion Skills, GSAP, anime.js, Motion, Motion Canvas, MCP for Blender, three.js, After Effects MCP. Easiest start: HyperFrames or Remotion with its skills, GSAP for easing. Prompt animation principles: anticipation before the jump, squash on landing, follow-through on the ears.

title: AI video prompt recipe: subject, action, setting, camera, light
prompt_text: Recipe: subject + action + setting + camera + light. Example prompt: "A ceramic cup on a rainy cafe window ledge. Steam rises. Slow push-in. Soft morning light." Change one detail per test.

title: 6-second looping HTML animation with style variants
prompt_text: make a 6 second looping animation in html with a replay button. Then add one style: maps, paper cut, blueprint, kinetic type, liquid morph (e.g. "melt a circle into a star and back").
